description: This file implements the GstDispatcherThread class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages in a separate thread, managing state changes, errors, and message dispatching within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThread
classes.description: A class that manages a dedicated thread for handling GStreamer bus messages, including state changes and errors, and communicates with a client.
